src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Continue any diagonal line containing at least two cells of the same
    # non-background color, in both directions.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color in (0,1,3):
            continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            lines={}
            for r,c in pts:
                key=c-dr*0 # placeholder
                # invariant for this diagonal slope
                key=(c-r) if dc==1 else (c+r)
                lines.setdefault(key,[]).append((r,c))
            for line in lines.values():
                if len(line)<2: continue
                line.sort()
                # A diagonal is extended when points are aligned; fill the
                # full diagonal segment through the aligned points.
                a,b=line[0],line[-1]
                if (b[0]-a[0])==0: continue
                step=1 if b[1]>a[1] else -1
                if abs(b[1]-a[1]) != b[0]-a[0]: continue
                r,c=a
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    if out[r][c] in (0,1,3): out[r][c]=color
                    r-=1; c-=step
                r,c=b
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    if out[r][c] in (0,1,3): out[r][c]=color
                    r+=1; c+=step
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Continue any diagonal line containing at least two cells of the same
    # non-background color, in both directions.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color not in (6,7):
            continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            lines={}
            for r,c in pts:
                key=c-dr*0 # placeholder
                # invariant for this diagonal slope
                key=(c-r) if dc==1 else (c+r)
                lines.setdefault(key,[]).append((r,c))
            for line in lines.values():
                if len(line)<2: continue
                line.sort()
                # A diagonal is extended when points are aligned; fill the
                # full diagonal segment through the aligned points.
                a,b=line[0],line[-1]
                if (b[0]-a[0])==0: continue
                step=1 if b[1]>a[1] else -1
                if abs(b[1]-a[1]) != b[0]-a[0]: continue
                r,c=a
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
